description: Review of the commit that made a string mark a name only where a member's name is read: `const keys = ['skip']` holds a string of the vocabulary in a container, and `ctx[keys[0]]()` reads the context's member by it. A name bound to a container that holds such a string counts in any callee, at any depth: at least a WARN that it may skip 'adds'. The real runner skips the test.
